method: blind: X = M111 final (client d2d27404, server xframe=0 and its single-slot DeepCache; the strips judge-end-to-end.json used), Y = the build M113 closed with (cross-frame attention, per-stream DeepCache, seeds per capture kind, atrium/vestibule/desert/baths prompts); walking filmstrips, 8 frames 0.15 s apart, all 8 zones, headless WebKit 1280x720; labels mapped back to M111/now below

ghosts_now.vestibule: Same rotated translucent panes over the whole frame; right ~15% is flat unpainted purple with stacked hard rectangles; pale block at lower left (frames 5-7); tiny standing figure in a lit doorway/mirror on the right wall (frames 0-3).
ghosts_now.nave: Vertical see-through pane edges at the same places as [the old build], plus a bright thick vertical bar at right (frame 6) and dark vertical drip lines near the centre; smoky cloud blob at right; dark mottled patch under the rose window. No figure.
ghosts_now.stacks: Same straight hard edge across the top (frames 0-5); faceted disc with a pale light spill beneath it (frame 0); hairline wire across the left (frames 6-7); hard dark block inside the lit ring (frame 7).
ghosts_now.geode: Faint thin hex/triangle lines over the purple floor; otherwise essentially clean.
ghosts_now.baths: Row of 3-5 dark human silhouettes standing in the glowing far arch (every frame); large translucent teal swooshes from the arcades to the tunnel; thin translucent arch outlines along both sides; white horizontal wall lines; hard-edged translucent panels on the water (frames 5-7).
ghosts_now.garden: Misty oval hole of sky and mountains cut into the foliage at left; soft vertical cut where the villa meets the right-hand tree; horizontal seam across the left hedge; hairline scribbles and stakes on the lawn; white fountain fragment at the right edge.
ghosts_now.atrium: Wavy white torn-paper border around the whole image with grey grid lines outside it (frame 0), wavy fragments at the edges later; pseudo-text inscription on the lower-right slab (frames 1-7); fine crosshatch mesh on the ceiling; faint arch-shaped ghost on the lit wall; small dark figure/doorway at the corridor end; misaligned bench glitch at centre (frames 0-2).
ghosts_now.desert: Same flat pink side slabs, plus a pale rectangle on the left wall; grey tiled rectangle behind the tower top; cropped sun disc at the top edge; black tiled strip across the bottom (frame 4); smeared right third; dark smudge on the right balustrade.

now_weak_spots: the nave goes murky and shallow: a fixed shaft of light, a smoke blob, streaky vertical texture
the desert is soft: smeared stairs and right third, a grey tiled patch behind the tower; a stair in a pink box more than a desert
translucent teal swooshes and a row of dark silhouettes in the baths' far arch
the vestibule's right edge is flat unpainted purple with stacked rectangles
a torn-paper border and grid lines in the atrium's first frame, and pseudo-text on a slab
smeared shelves in the stacks and a misty oval hole of sky in the garden's foliage
notes: many ghosts sit at identical positions in both builds and look like geometry showing through rather than a build difference (vestibule panes, nave pane edges, stacks top edge, geode floor lines, baths arch outlines, garden hedge seam, desert side slabs)
the new build's steadiness sometimes shades into looking frozen (nave, desert); its detail drops where the scene is foggy or wide
the old build's detail advantage is real but local: the nave, the desert butte, the stair treads in the stacks

reviewer's own crude cross-check (160x90 blurred, mean consecutive-frame difference, old/new): vestibule 8.7/7.4, nave 7.4/4.9, stacks 7.1/6.5, geode 6.3/5.4, baths 3.7/3.1, garden 6.6/5.0, atrium 8.7/6.1, desert 4.5/4.2
summary: I would rather walk through [the new build]. It keeps each place's identity in all eight zones, and in the atrium, geode and vestibule it is also much crisper and more legible, while [the old build]'s atrium is an unreadable grey smear and its geode, garden and vestibule re-invent their focal shapes every few steps. [the old build]'s advantage is real but narrower: more detail and depth in the nave and desert, and slightly in stacks, where [the new build] goes murky or soft. The margin is clear overall ([the new build] is steadier 8/8 and more coherent in 5 of 8), not a toss-up.
